description:
Welcome to Syracuse Time & Alarm’s Channel!

Syracuse Time & Alarm Co., Inc. takes pride in understanding your needs and create systems that meet your highly specialized demands. Allow our sales engineers to help you design the solution and our factory certified technicians will install, configure and certify a solution to meet your specifications.

Our product lines include fire alarm and security systems, access control, intercoms, professional sound systems, time management and clock systems.

The tech portion of our channel specializes in fire alarm system operation, programming, troubleshooting, and technician training with a focus on Notifier and Gamewell-FCI panels.

Our videos cover real-world testing methods using tools like oscilloscopes and digital multimeters to diagnose faults.

Whether you’re a fire alarm technician, systems engineer, inspector, or facility maintenance professional, this channel gives you hands-on training and diagnostic techniques.
